source: GtRNAdb (UCSC Lowe Lab), Homo sapiens tRNA gene set
build: tRNAscan-SE 2.0 filtered nuclear tRNA gene set from hg38-tRNAs.fa; SeC (selenocysteine, anticodon TCA) excluded; genes counted per anticodon (initiator + elongator Met merged at CAT). Independently re-counted from a sha256-pinned FASTA with zero mismatches; cross-checked vs GtRNAdb hg19 and HGNC.
genome: GRCh38 / hg38 (nuclear only; no mitochondrial tRNAs)
note: Real tRNA gene copy numbers by anticodon. tAI relative adaptiveness is derived via the dos Reis et al. (2004) wobble model (optimised s-values) as in the tai R package; see bt4.biomodels.codon.tai. Reproducible from this file's SHA-256. Source database: GtRNAdb (Chan & Lowe, Nucleic Acids Res 2016, doi:10.1093/nar/gkv1309), predictions by tRNAscan-SE 2.0 (Chan et al. 2021, doi:10.1093/nar/gkab688). GtRNAdb states no explicit data license: citation-gated academic use, NOT a CC/public-domain grant.
